title: The aerial tram
notes: Silver Tram tower (2921, 982, -2096), the frame of ref/c-tram-1.jpg: a 10 m truck to the right at cabin height, 50 mm. Shot 14 reuses this path in the summer state. The two cabins (SkiTramCabin) run on two track ropes about 20 m apart and cross near the tower; they depart about every 45 game minutes (seen at 17:24, 18:09, 18:53, 09:50 and 10:35) and dwell at the stations in between. Start the take when the cabin descending from the top passes x 2952 (about 60 to 80 m before the tower on the camera's side); the other cabin climbs into frame below the tower at the same time. At sim speed 1 a game minute is about 12 s real here: run the sim at 8 between passes and keep capture mode off until the cabin passes x 2995, or the polling stalls the pre-roll. Take 2 used Time of Day 14.5. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
